about: Every address outside the app that Docxtor can call, with what calls it, when, and what is sent. e2e/privacy.spec.ts records the requests of the app and the embedded editor and fails when the hosts it sees are not exactly these; PRIVACY.md says the same list in words (scripts/check-privacy.mjs, in npm test, checks that every host here is in PRIVACY.md and no other is). `when` says what it takes before the request goes out: automatic (nothing: it happens as the app or the editor is used), when you ask (you look something up), after you set it up (you choose a provider and give a key, or a Zotero library), after you turn it on (an extension that is off until you turn it on). `onByDefault` says whether the feature is switched on in a fresh install.

hosts.what: Google Fonts style sheets: Inter and the look-alikes of Word's fonts for the embedded editor, and the twenty families of the Google Fonts extension in the app
hosts.calledBy: packages/editor/src/fonts.ts (ensureFonts, the embedded editor's `fonts` option), web/src/builtins.ts (the Google Fonts extension)
hosts.sends: the font family names in the address; Google also sees your IP address, your browser and the address of the page
seenIn: a document with a Google font

hosts.what: The font files the Google Fonts style sheets name
hosts.calledBy: the browser, for the style sheets above
hosts.sends: nothing but the request for a font file; Google also sees your IP address, your browser and the address of the page
seenIn: a document with a Google font

hosts.what: Tools, Dictionary: definitions of a word
hosts.sends: the word you look up (the one at the caret or in the search box)

hosts.what: More synonyms and opposites in the thesaurus
hosts.sends: the word you look up in the thesaurus

hosts.what: Citations, From a DOI or URL: the details of a paper
Zotero on this computer (its local interface), when you open Citations, From Zotero
hosts.sends: the words you search for; nothing leaves your computer
the words you search for, your Zotero user ID in the address and your API key in a header

hosts.what: Grammar checking by LanguageTool (the server in its settings; this one unless you change it)
hosts.sends: the text of your document (paragraph by paragraph, again after edits), its language, and your LanguageTool user name and key if you gave them

hosts.what: The assistant, with Anthropic as the provider
hosts.sends: your message, the document (its name, its text and the part you selected) and what the assistant's tools read, with your API key in a header

hosts.what: The assistant, with OpenAI as the provider
hosts.sends: your message, the document (its name, its text and the part you selected) and what the assistant's tools read, with your API key in a header

hosts.what: The assistant, with OpenRouter as the provider
hosts.sends: your message, the document (its name, its text and the part you selected) and what the assistant's tools read, with your API key in a header, and the address of the page (OpenRouter asks for it)

hosts.what: The assistant, with Google Gemini as the provider
hosts.sends: your message, the document (its name, its text and the part you selected) and what the assistant's tools read, with your API key in a header

hosts.what: The assistant, with Groq as the provider
hosts.sends: your message, the document (its name, its text and the part you selected) and what the assistant's tools read, with your API key in a header

hosts.what: The assistant, with Mistral as the provider
hosts.sends: your message, the document (its name, its text and the part you selected) and what the assistant's tools read, with your API key in a header

hosts.what: The assistant, with Ollama running on this computer as the provider
hosts.sends: your message and the document, to a program on your own computer; nothing leaves it

hosts.what: The assistant, with LM Studio running on this computer as the provider
hosts.sends: your message and the document, to a program on your own computer; nothing leaves it

anyAddress.what: A citation style from an address you type (Citations, Style, Add a style from a CSL file)
anyAddress.sends: nothing but the request for that file
seenIn: a citation style from an address

anyAddress.what: A picture from an address you type (Insert, Image, From a URL)
anyAddress.sends: nothing but the request for that picture, with no cookies and no referrer
seenIn: a picture from a web address

anyAddress.what: A picture on the web in HTML you paste (the browser fetches it so it can be kept in the document)
anyAddress.sends: nothing but the request for that picture, with no cookies
seenIn: a paste with a picture on the web

anyAddress.what: A picture a document links on the web: its placeholder shows a button, Show linked pictures, and only that fetches it
anyAddress.sends: nothing but the request for that picture; the site that holds it sees that you opened the document

anyAddress.what: The assistant, with the Custom provider or a base address you give for another provider (a gateway, a proxy of your own)
anyAddress.sends: what the assistant sends to any provider, with your key in a header
